music_states._doc: Stem levels per game state. In play the music sits well under the hits (playtest: music and ambience too loud, SFX must lead): aim/flight/destruction bases are 6 dB below menu-relative levels.

collapse._doc: Collapse layer (Sound._on_break): breaks within window_ms are one fall. Passing a tier (count of breaks or summed block mass) plays its sound once at the breaks' centre; settle_ms after the last break a rubble tail plays.

ads._doc: Interstitial: one after every interstitial_every_matches matches (a match = a finished level, or one left or restarted after a shot; wins and losses both count; training never). Shown only at the break when the player taps a results or pause button (Next, Retry, Map, Restart), never during play, never with Remove Ads. Counter is saved (Save.data.ad_matches). load_retry_s: retry after a failed ad load.

story._novel_doc: A level's story scene plays only if the level brings something the campaign has not shown before: a hero, a mechanism kind, a material, one of these gadget shapes, a captive, bolts, an engineer or a boss (Data.novelty).

promo._doc: Home-screen feature showcase (src/ui/promo_popup.gd): first home visit of each session, then every N visits, never sooner than min_gap_s after the last one and at most max_per_day times. Cards for owned or still-locked things are skipped.

campaign_end._doc: Screen after the last campaign level (src/ui/campaign_end.gd). Opens from WHAT'S NEXT? on the results and from Play on home once every level is won.
campaign_end.title: ALL REALMS CONQUERED!
campaign_end.subtitle: You smashed all {levels} fortresses and earned {stars} / {max} stars.
campaign_end.orin_says: Well done, Commander! My scouts have spotted new fortresses beyond the mist. I am forging the road there right now: new levels are coming soon. Until then, chase every star and try the Special Missions!

energy._doc: Army energy (src/game/energy.gd, src/ui/energy_ui.gd). Each campaign attempt costs bars; refill_s[i] is the time for the next bar when i bars are full (fast first, slower after). A rewarded ad can always top up the bars for one level.
energy.ready_text: Your soldiers are ready again in %s.
energy.how_text: Each battle costs energy. The first bar comes back quickly, the rest take longer.
energy.full_text: Your army is fully rested. To battle!
energy.no_ad_text: No video available right now. Try again in a moment.

training._doc: Practice range before the first level with a new hero (Level.training, data/training). Opens with a How-to card (title, steps, best). In flight, when the hero passes the fort front + tap_dx (or falls short), time slows to slowmo_scale and a TAP NOW prompt shows the 'tap' text until the ability is used or prompt_hold_s real seconds pass. Other steps: aim (hero loaded), fly (launched), done (ability used), again (after a good shot), missed (no tap last shot).
training.done_body: You know how %s works. Time for the real battle!
training.retry_body: %s is ready for battle. Practise again, or march on.

stone.title: Rocky's SLAM
steps: Drag anywhere on the screen to stretch the catapult, then let go to fling Rocky.
While he is flying over the tower, tap anywhere on the screen.
Rocky drops straight down like a boulder and crushes stone and the guards below.
stone.best: Best on: stone towers and guards under a roof.
stone.aim: This is Rocky! Drag anywhere on the screen to stretch the catapult, then let go to fling him at the stone tower.
stone.tap: Rocky is over the tower. Tap to slam down!
stone.done: The slam smashes through stone and the guards under it.
stone.again: Fly above the tower, then tap to slam down.

fire.title: Blaze's FIRE DASH
steps: Drag back on the catapult and let go to fling Blaze.
Before he reaches the tower, tap anywhere on the screen.
He speeds forward and sets the wood he touches on fire. The fire keeps spreading along wood.
fire.best: Best on: wooden towers. Weak against stone.
fire.aim: Meet Blaze! Drag back and let go to fling him at the tower.
fire.tap: Tap to dash into the wood!
fire.done: Fire spreads along every wooden beam it touches.
fire.again: Hit the wooden tower, then tap to dash.

bomb.title: Boomer's BOOM
steps: Fling Boomer into the middle of the guards.
Tap anywhere on the screen to blow him up, in the air or after he lands.
If you don't tap, he explodes by himself a moment after landing.
bomb.best: Best on: guards standing close together.
bomb.aim: Meet Boomer! Fling him into the guards.
bomb.tap: He is among the guards. Tap to explode!
bomb.done: Boom! One blast hits everything nearby.
bomb.again: Land between the guards, then tap to explode.

cyclone.title: Twister's TORNADO
steps: Fling Twister high, towards the top of the tower.
When he is above the planks, tap anywhere on the screen.
He turns into a tornado that lifts light planks and guards and throws them away.
cyclone.best: Best on: light wood and guards in the open. Weak against stone.
cyclone.aim: Meet Twister! Fling him over the tall tower.
cyclone.done: The tornado lifts light planks and guards and throws them.
cyclone.again: Fly over the planks, then tap for the tornado.

quake.title: Quaky's EARTHBREAK
steps: Just in front of the tower, tap anywhere on the screen.
He dives into the ground and the shockwave shakes the whole fort. Thin legs break first.
quake.best: Best on: towers standing on thin supports.
quake.aim: Meet Quaky! Fling him in front of the tower.
quake.tap: Tap to dive into the ground!
quake.done: The shockwave shakes the tower's legs. Weak supports break first.
quake.again: Tap above the ground near the tower for a big quake.

training.fly: Watch %s fly. Get ready to tap!
training.missed: You didn't tap that time. When TAP NOW shows, tap anywhere on the screen.

profile._doc: Commander name on the home card (MainMenu._open_rename). Free from free_rename_level, otherwise rename_gems.

rolling_log._doc: Logs and wheels ram what they roll into (Block._tick_roll): once per body per roll while faster than min_speed; below reset_speed the log can hit the same pieces again.

crush._doc: A released rope load (and wrecking balls/cages) smashes what it lands on: damage = speed * damage_per_speed to each block/archer it touches while faster than min_speed.

drawbridge._doc: When a drawbridge lands it slams: guards and blocks within reach_px of the deck take deck_damage and are pushed down, and a shockwave at the tip knocks the next tower (tip_radius_px, tip_impulse, tip_damage).

currencies._doc: Wallet: coins (earned, spent on engines/upgrades) and gems (premium, almost only from purchases). Premium rewards only on first clears.

lever._doc: Lever switch: any shot, moving block or blast flips it and fires its triggers.

rotor._doc: Windmill arms / orbiting shield plates (rotating kinematic body). Hub hit jams a windmill.

rune_switch._doc: Hidden switch inside the fortress; glows once no block covers it.

trapdoor._doc: Floor panel on a hinge; opens when triggered so what stands on it falls.

boss_rig._doc: Boss stages (src/game/boss_rig.gd): cores shield the boss, cannons shoot soldiers, engineers rebuild.

special_pack._doc: Master Sieges: ten hard fixed-loadout mechanic puzzles shown on Challenges, unlocked by campaign stars.

siege_weapons._doc: Distinct siege engines. Level requirement reveals the engine; unlock_cost buys it. Track effects are real multipliers applied by Progression.

catapult.name: Royal Catapult
catapult.desc: Reliable arcs. Torsion power and a reinforced cup make every direct hit count.

ballista.desc: A low, fast shot for front walls and iron. Its rail sacrifices blast size for direct damage.

upgrades._doc: Vanguard tracks. Siege-engine tracks live under siege_weapons.<id>.tracks and cost coins only.

hero_addons._doc: Decorations worn by Rocky (heroes: stone only for now). One per slot (head, face). Sold as Play one-time products (shop.products addon_<id>). Looks only, never stronger. Art: assets/art/svg/addon_<id>.svg, drawn for a body radius of 30 SVG units. pos = sprite centre in body radii from the body centre, rot in degrees.

realm_chests._doc: Per realm (15 levels, 45 stars), claimable on the map at these star counts.

secrets._doc: One hidden map scroll per realm (a crate with decor 'scroll'). Finding it unlocks that realm's secret level.

gadgets._doc: Round 4 gadgets (src/game/gadget.gd): portals, gravity fields, magnets, bounce pads, pressure plates, relays (timed multi-switch) and repair crystals, conveyor belts, fans and fuses.

feats._doc: Level challenges on the Achievements screen (src/game/feats.gd). Every max_shots, chain and fast entry was checked winnable with tools/record_trailer.py --search.

daily._doc: 7-day login calendar (src/ui/daily_rewards.gd). Missing a day does not reset the streak.

spin._doc: Spin wheel (src/ui/spin_wheel.gd). First spin each day free, then up to ads_per_day with a rewarded ad. weight = relative odds.

play._doc: Google Play In-App Review and In-App Updates (src/autoload/play_services.gd). Review: asked after a win with min_stars from min_level, after min_sessions sessions, at most max_asks times, gap_days apart, delay_s after the results panel (Play may still decide not to show it). Updates: one check per session on the home screen (delay_s after it appears, never before the notification question). Release priority (tools/release.py upload --priority 0-5) >= immediate_priority opens Play's blocking update screen; lower offers the background download at most every ask_gap_hours per version.

cloud._doc: Play Games sign-in starts signin_delay_s after the first home screen. Cloud save (one Saved Games snapshot) only while signed in: uploaded after a level at most every min_interval_s and whenever the game goes to the background. device_keys stay as they are on this phone when a cloud save is loaded.

shop._doc: Play Billing catalogue. Product ids must match Play Console exactly. Contents are fixed (no random rewards). price_hint_usd is only for docs and debug builds: the real localized price always comes from Google Play.
